vocabulary.meaning_en: a request to come to an event
vocabulary.note_ar: الفعل: invite. وفي العامية: an invite
vocabulary.note_en: Verb: invite. Informal noun: an invite.

vocabulary.meaning_en: say yes to an invitation or offer
vocabulary.example: I'm happy to accept your invitation.
I had to turn down the invitation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a meeting of people who haven't seen each other for a long time
vocabulary.example: Our college reunion is next month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a meeting of people, often family and friends
vocabulary.example: We're having a small family gathering.
I was really chuffed to be invited.
A hike on Saturday? I'm up for that!
The dinner clashes with my exam.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a reason you give for not doing something
say no in a kind way so the person isn't hurt
vocabulary.example: Give a reason and let them down gently.
People get browned off if you always say no.

vocabulary.meaning_en: cancel or move plans to make free time
vocabulary.example: I'll try to clear my diary for Friday.

fine_lines.title: Positive, negative and neutral replies
words: I'm sorry, I can't make it.
I'll see what I can do.
fine_lines.explanation_ar: إيجابي = تقبل الدعوة. سلبي = ترفض بلطف وتذكر سببًا. محايد = لا تقول نعم أو لا الآن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Positive = you accept. Negative = you refuse politely with a reason. Neutral = you don't say yes or no yet.

examples.sentence: A family dinner on Friday? I'm looking forward to it.

examples.word: I'll see what I can do.
examples.sentence: Leave it with me. I'll see what I can do.

fine_lines.title: I'd love to vs I'd hate to
words: I'd hate to miss it, but ...
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلتاهما تُستخدمان للرفض المهذب: تُظهر أنك تريد الحضور، ثم تذكر السبب بعد but.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both are polite refusals: they show you want to go, then give a reason after "but".

examples.sentence: I'd love to go, but I'm away on business.

examples.word: I'd hate to miss it, but ...
examples.sentence: I'd hate to miss it, but I have to work that day.

expressions.example: Dinner at eight? Great, I'll see you there.
Thanks for the invitation. I'm looking forward to it.

expressions.phrase: I wouldn't miss it for the world.
expressions.example: Your graduation? I wouldn't miss it for the world.
A college reunion? I can't wait!

expressions.meaning_en: Informal British: very pleased (and honoured) to be asked.
expressions.example: You want me to give the speech? I'm really chuffed.
Thanks for asking me. It's great to be included.
Football on Sunday? Count me in.

expressions.meaning_en: Informal: I want to do it.
expressions.example: A hike in the mountains? I'm up for that.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite refusal with a reason.
expressions.example: I'd love to go, but I have a business trip.
I can't come this time. Perhaps next time.

expressions.phrase: I'm sorry, I can't make it.
expressions.example: I'm sorry, I can't make it, but thanks for the invitation anyway.

expressions.meaning_ar: شكرًا على الدعوة على أي حال.
expressions.meaning_en: Thanks the person even though you can't come.
expressions.example: I can't come, but thanks for the invitation anyway.

expressions.phrase: I hate to say no, but ...
expressions.meaning_en: Prepares the person for a refusal.
expressions.example: I hate to say no, but it clashes with another event.

expressions.phrase: I'd hate to miss it, but I'm afraid I'll have to.
expressions.meaning_ar: يحزنني أن يفوتني، لكن أخشى أنني مضطر.
expressions.example: I'd hate to miss the reunion, but I'm afraid I'll have to.

expressions.phrase: Keep me in mind for next time.
expressions.example: I'm busy this week, but keep me in mind for next time.

expressions.phrase: I'll do my best, but I can't promise.
expressions.meaning_ar: سأبذل جهدي، لكن لا أستطيع أن أعد.
expressions.example: I'll do my best to come, but I can't promise.

expressions.meaning_en: Asks for the date again, gives you time to think.

expressions.phrase: Does it have to be that day?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يجب أن يكون في ذلك اليوم؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asks if the date can change.
expressions.example: Does it have to be that day? I'm away until Tuesday.

expressions.phrase: Leave it with me. I'll see what I can do.
expressions.meaning_ar: اترك الأمر لي. سأرى ما يمكنني فعله.
expressions.meaning_en: A neutral reply; you'll answer later.
expressions.example: Leave it with me. I'll see what I can do and call you tomorrow.

grammar.title: I'd love to / I'd hate to + verb, but ...
grammar.explanation_ar: I'd = I would. بعد love to / hate to نستخدم الفعل الأساسي، ثم but والسبب. هذا التركيب يجعل الرفض مهذبًا.
grammar.explanation_en: I'd = I would. After "love to / hate to" use the base verb, then "but" and a reason. This makes a refusal polite.
examples: I'd love to go, but I'm working.
I'd hate to miss it, but I have an exam.
I'd love to come, but I'm away that weekend.

grammar.title: look forward to + noun / -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: to هنا حرف جر، فيأتي بعدها اسم أو فعل بـ ing.
grammar.explanation_en: Here "to" is a preposition, so use a noun or -ing.
examples: I'm looking forward to seeing everyone.
We look forward to the reunion.

questions.question: Which reply ACCEPTS an invitation?
choices: I'm sorry, I can't make it.
I'll see what I can do.
Does it have to be that day?
questions.explanation_ar: Count me in = احسبني معكم، أي قبول.

questions.question: I'm looking forward to ___ everyone.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد look forward to نستخدم ing.

questions.question: Which is a NEUTRAL reply?
choices: I wouldn't miss it for the world.
I'm sorry, I can't make it.
I'll do my best, but I can't promise.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه العبارة لا تقول نعم أو لا.
questions.explanation_en: It says neither yes nor no.

questions.question: "The party clashes with my exam" means:
choices: They are at the same time.
The party is after the exam.

questions.question: I'd love ___, but I'm away that weekend.
"I wouldn't miss it for the world" means:
questions.explanation_en: It means you will definitely come.

questions.question: Why should you give a reason when you say no?
choices: To let the person down gently.
questions.explanation_ar: لكي ترفض بلطف ولا تجرح مشاعر الشخص.
questions.explanation_en: To refuse kindly without hurting feelings.

questions.question: "I'm up for that" means:
questions.explanation_ar: be up for = متحمّس ويريد المشاركة.
questions.explanation_en: "Be up for" = want to do it.
